anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a standardized method for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a technical specification/tool, not a description of the somatomotor dataset.

anchors.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper proposes MEG-BIDS, an extension of the BIDS standard to organize and share MEG data, describing a general data structure/format rather than introducing this specific dataset.

metadata.methods_description: MRI (T1w), MEG, and EEG data were acquired while median nerve electrical stimuli were delivered at the right wrist, and subjects responded by lifting their left hand index finger. Three anatomical fiducials (nasion, left and right pre-auricular points) were digitized to co-register MEG with MRI. Trigger codes recorded stimulus (32) and response (16) events.
